summary.text: Yudelka Tapia is the Democratic nominee for re-election in NY Assembly District 86, a West Bronx seat she has held since November 2021. Born in the Dominican Republic, she holds a master's degree from Hunter College and worked as a Senior Auditor for the New York City Comptroller's Office. She serves on the Banks, Corporations, Economic Development, Housing, Labor and Mental Health committees.

paragraphs.text: Yudelka Tapia was born in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic, and attended O&M University there, where she organized fellow students against domestic violence and political corruption and served as president of the Unión Democrática de Mujeres, a national organization that organized and educated women.
She later earned a Master of Science in Urban Policy and Leadership from Hunter College.
Tapia immigrated to the West Bronx more than 30 years ago and raised four sons there, sending them to New York City public schools.
She worked for 23 years as a Senior Auditor for the New York City Comptroller's Office.
In her community she served as PTA President at Roosevelt High School and as an Executive Committee member of the local 1407-DC 37 union.
Tapia won the November 2, 2021 special general election for Assembly District 86, succeeding Victor Pichardo, and assumed office the next day.
She was re-elected in the November 2022 and November 2024 general elections.
The district consists of the neighborhoods of University Heights, Morris Heights, Mount Eden, Kingsbridge, Tremont and Fordham.
She is currently assigned to the Assembly's Banks; Corporations, Authorities and Commissions; Economic Development, Job Creation, Commerce and Industry; Housing; Labor; and Mental Health committees.
